decisions.decision:
Do the work end to end on main:
1) In pro-client.tsx, remove WEBHOOK_URL and send the form through logForm (lib/form-log.ts) with form 'pro', the way the other funnel forms do. Then redirect as before. If the Work Tracker has no Pro tab, add one through the Apps Script receiver.
2) In the Dodo webhook route, drop the NEXT_PUBLIC_LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL fallback (line 19) and delete that line from .env.example.
3) In probe-masterclass-form.mjs and shoot-success.mjs, point the route stubs at the Apps Script receiver.
4) Run `git grep -i n8n -- app/src app/scripts app/.env.example`. It must return nothing.
5) Make a test submission on /pro named 'wiring-probe' and confirm the row lands in the Tracker.
6) Run probe-workshop.mjs and probe-seat-payments.mjs.
7) Commit and push, then republish the mirror (export-static.sh, rsync to live/site, push).
8) Close T-087 and T-030. Leave the /pro copy to T-071.
